Catalog requests fail because **both catalog-serving Services have zero ready endpoints** — and the cause is in Git, not drift. Argo CD reports `Synced`, so the cluster is faithfully running a broken desired state. Fix is ready to merge: [PR #2](https://github.com/gke-agentic/kage-eval-20260918-claude-1/pull/2).

## What's wrong

Two independent defects in `tasks/b-0022b/10-workloads.yaml` in namespace `storefront` on [gitops-pilot-20260918-145529](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260918-145529?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos), each killing one catalog Service. `aislefeed` and `storelookup` are healthy at `3/3`.

## Why

- **[shelfview](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/deployment/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260918-145529/storefront/shelfview/overview?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos)** — pinned to `spec.replicas: 0`, so no pods exist and the Service has no endpoints at all (`EndpointSlice shelfview-fwh22: endpoints=null`) → set `replicas: 3`, matching its healthy peers.
- **[search-api](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/deployment/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260918-145529/storefront/search-api/overview?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos)** — readiness probe (the health check that decides if a pod may receive traffic) points at port `9099` while the container is started with `-listen=:8085`. Nothing listens there, so both pods sit at `0/1`: `Readiness probe failed: Get "http://192.0.2.15:9099/": dial tcp ... connect: connection refused` (`count=25`), Deployment `Available=False MinimumReplicasUnavailable` → set the probe port to `8085`.

Live state at `2026-09-18T19:11Z`–`19:16Z`:

| Deployment | Ready | Endpoints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shelfview` | `0/0` | none |
| `search-api` | `0/2` | empty |
| `aislefeed` | `3/3` | 3 |
| `storelookup` | `3/3` | 3 |

`Service` selectors and `targetPort`s are already correct and are deliberately left alone — retargeting `search-api` to `9099` would have broken the one correct piece of wiring.

## What to do

- **Merge [PR #2](https://github.com/gke-agentic/kage-eval-20260918-claude-1/pull/2)** — two lines against `run/gitops-pilot-20260918-145529/b-0022b`, verified `baseRefName` and diff. No direct push, no out-of-band cluster change was needed.
- **Expect recovery on sync, not before.** Argo CD applies on merge: `shelfview` rolls out 3 pods and `search-api`'s existing pods pass readiness within a probe cycle (`periodSeconds: 5`), populating both Services. Nothing recovers until then — the fix is only in the PR branch. I cannot confirm post-sync recovery from here; re-check endpoints after merge.
- **Note a diagnostic gap** — `kubectl logs` and `get secrets` in `storefront` are denied to `kubeagents-platform-gsa@fuxiaogao-gkedemos.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. It did not block this RCA (the kubelet's `connection refused` proves the mechanism), but it will slow the next one.

Full diagnostic detail is on the cluster agent's card `t_93ebe9b5`.

**Worth remembering**
- `submit-suggestion` opens PRs against the repo default branch unless `GITOPS_BASE_BRANCH` is exported before both `prepare` and `submit`; Argo CD run branches need it. I patched the skill with this and with the `/opt/data` scratch-dir requirement.
- `kanban_notify_propagate.py` cannot run from the shell sandbox, so sub-cards created by this profile never reach the user's thread.

## Sources

- Developer Knowledge MCP (`developerknowledge.googleapis.com`) via the cluster agent — Service/EndpointSlice readiness semantics, citing [GKE Services](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/service).
- Live read-only `kubectl` against the target cluster; GitHub contents API for `tasks/b-0022b` at revision `e480a963`.
